extracted_stakeholders.name: Local Communities

extracted_stakeholders.name: Non-governmental organizations (NGOs)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Support improvements in land governance and provide advocacy.

extracted_factors.Label: Oil Palm Expansion
extracted_factors.Description: Oil palm plantations are a major direct cause of land change in Sumatra and Kalimantan, driven by the demand for palm oil.

extracted_factors.Label: Property Rights Issues
extracted_factors.Description: Property rights disputes contribute to land change, reflecting the struggle over land ownership and use between governments, companies, and local communities.

extracted_factors.Label: Transmigration Policy
extracted_factors.Description: Government-led relocation of populations to Sumatra and Kalimantan, impacting land use and contributing to forest conversion.

extracted_factors.Label: Lack of Institutional Capacity
extracted_factors.Description: Weak governance and poor enforcement of land management regulations contribute to uncontrolled land change.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation
extracted_factors.Description: Result of direct drivers like agricultural and forestry expansions leading to the loss of natural forests.
